description: This file defines the DomainListener class, which handles custom domain routing and redirection logic within a Symfony-based PHP application. It manages domain-related request redirection and controller assignment for multi-domain setups.

classes.name: CustomDomains\EventListener\DomainListener
classes.description: Listener class to manage domain-specific routing and redirection in a Symfony application, supporting custom domains and multilingual URLs.

methods.name: onRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming requests to perform domain-based redirection logic, ensuring requests are routed to appropriate domains or redirected accordingly.

methods.name: onController
methods.description: Assigns the appropriate controller based on the domain and path, and manages URL rewrites or redirects for index pages in multi-domain setups.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the array of Symfony kernel events this listener subscribes to, with associated handler methods.
